snippet.title: Make Way | World Tour Update and Legends DLC Pack Announcement
snippet.description:
Cross the finish line in style with the upcoming free ‘World Tour’ Update and paid ‘Legend DLC Pack’ for Make Way, launching May 14th on all platforms!

This free content will automatically unlock for all players after downloading a new update May 14th. This update also introduces a new team-based mode, more improvements to matchmaking, and extra optimisations. 

Alongside this, there will also be a paid DLC in the form of the ‘Legends Vehicle Pack’, featuring our spin on 10 iconic vehicles inspired by legendary cars from the world of sport and classic cinema.

Follow Secret Mode: https://linktr.ee/wearesecretmode
